documented_probe: C-5b5e6c73 (compute and include derived statistics fields): reference floor is hard but the covering task exercises it at medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases. Documented probe waiver.
notes: Medium derives mostly from quantitative_correctness (exact median/trimmed/bootstrap statistics must match tolerance) and hidden_case_generalization (the agent must write a reusable solver, not a one-off output), plus adversarial_inputs for the deliberately noisy CSV (blank/non-numeric cells, whitespace-padded headers, negative and extreme values, single-reading devices). Low resource pressure, no multi-step orchestration, no dangerous actions, so the total stays in the 10-17 medium band.
